title: Goal guard test

bubbles.title: Goal command
bubbles.hint: Set, change and clear the goal; check show and switch print it. Boundary: goal only.

bubbles.title: Guard commands
bubbles.hint: Add guards, drop guard N, drop all, bad N, text starting with - (after --). Boundary: guard only.

bubbles.title: Guards at done
bubbles.hint: Pop a bubble with guards set: are they visible at the stop, and does the agent check them before done? Boundary: done + guards.

bubbles.title: Review plan step
bubbles.hint: Did this plan (goal, guards, use cases before the sketch) give a focused track? Findings go to flow-analysis with add --to. Boundary: the plan step text.

goal: Test the plan step, goal and guards end to end
guards: Focus only on plan, goal and guards: no other CLI features
No source file changes: bugs found go to flow-analysis
